senses.gloss: शार्ग॑ m. a kind of bird, Maitr.
शार्ग॑ n. N. of various Sāmans (prob. w.r. for शार्ङ्ग, q.v.)
स॑र्ग m. (ifc. f(आ). ; fr. √ सृज्) letting go, discharging, voiding (as excrement), MBh.; R.
starting (a race-horse), racing, RV.
a herd let loose from a stable, any troop or host or swarm or multitude, ib.; Rājat.
a draught of air, gust of wind, RV.
a stream, gush, rush, downpour (of any fluid; acc. with √ कृ, ‘to cast or strike down’, RV.)
a dart, shot, ib.

emission or creation of matter, primary creation (as opp. to प्रतिसर्ग ‘secondary creation’), creation of the world (as opp. to its प्रलय ‘dissolution’, and स्थिति, ‘maintenance in existence’; 9 different creations are enumerated in BhP. iii, 10, 13; आ सर्गात्, ‘from the creation or beginning of the world’; सर्गे ‘in the created world’), Up.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
a created being, creature (with दैव ‘a divine creation’, ‘a god’), Ragh.
begetting, procreation, MBh.
origin, BhP.
offspring, a child, ib.
nature, natural property, disposition, tendency, Bhag. v, 19
effort, exertion, resolution, resolve, will, Ragh.; Śiś.
a section, chapter, book, canto (esp. in an epic poem)
assent, agreement, L.
fainting (= मोह), L.
implement of war, MBh. xi, 2165 (Nīlak.)
= विसर्ग, the aspiration at the end of a word, Cat.
N. of Śiva, MBh.
of a son of Rudra, Pur.
सर्ग &c. See p. 1182, col. 3.
शार्गाल more correctly सार्गाल, q.v.
सार्गल mfn. id., ib. (in the Kāṇva recension), Hariv.
obstructed, impeded, prevented, with held, Ragh.
सार्गाल mf(ई)n. (fr. सृगाल) relating or belonging to a jackal, MBh.
सर्ग—कर्तृ m. the creator (-त्व n.), Pañcar.
सर्ग—कर्तृ—त्व n.
सर्ग—कालीन mfn. relating to or happening at the time of creation, Sāṃkhyapr.
सर्ग—कृत् m. = -कर्तृ, Hariv.
सर्ग—क्रम m. the order of creation, MW.
सर्ग—तक्त or स॑र्ग—प्रतक्त (स॑र्ग-), mfn. dashing along in rapid motion, hastening, RV.
सर्ग—तक्त or स॑र्ग—प्रतक्त (स॑र्ग-), mfn. dashing along in rapid motion, hastening, RV.
सर्ग—प्रलय-कण्टकोद्धार m. N. of wk.
सर्ग—बन्ध m. ‘chapter-construction’, any poem or composition divided into sections or chapters (esp. a Mahā-kāvya or great poem), Kāvyād.; Sāh.
सर्गक mfn. producing, effecting, Sarvad.
सर्ग्य See पाणि-स्˚.
सा॑र्गड mfn. bolted, barred, ŚBr.
सार्गिक mfn. = सर्गाय प्रभवति, g. रंतापादि.
